subject: Questions on fitting SGLMM with INLA

messages.author: 32a9c1a2480183ec
messages.subject: Questions on fitting SGLMM with INLA
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I have been exploring INLA documents but couldn't find what I need. Could you please direct me to the right place.

I am trying to use INLA to fit spatial generalized linear mixed models for the Poisson and binary (logit link) data that are not on a grid. Specifically, I would like to compare INLA for the traditional SGLMM model (Eidsvik et al. 2009)  and INLA for SGLMM with predictive process (Eidsvik et al. 2010). Your help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,
Yawen

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Questions on fitting SGLMM with INLA

messages.author: 32a9c1a2480183ec
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Questions on fitting SGLMM with INLA
parts:
Hi Bob,

Thank you for your quick response. It seems that the tutorial mainly deals with SPDE approximation to the latent Gaussian models. For instance, example "Precipitation on Paran a" requires "spde <- inla.spde2.matern(prmesh2, alpha=2)".  Is there an option to fit the traditional SGLMM without spde approximation?


Best,
Yawen
